item.description: ### Fixed - **Sessions stop claiming to work after they've gone.** An agent that was killed, crashed, or whose terminal was closed could sit in the fleet as "working" indefinitely — keeping the menu bar icon animating and the lock screen asking about a session nobody could answer. A session that has said nothing for ten minutes now shows as idle. Nothing is deleted; it reappears as soon as it says anything. - **Fewer late notifications.** A push could hang on a dead connection for a full minute before giving up. Perch now gives up after ten seconds and tries once more, so an alert either arrives promptly or not at all.
